# What does a driving lesson really earn after the car?

> Free calculator for independent driving instructors: profit per lesson, break-even price, the price that reaches your take-home target and the cost of a block discount, after fuel, car wear, fixed costs, gaps and cancellations. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
